text:
oliver_cust: Hi — entered promo code in billing UI, got the green check and confirmation email, but my org balance still shows $0.00. Screenshot: https://img.redwood.example/claim-ok.png

maria_support: Sorry about that, can you share your org ID and the claim reference from the confirmation email?

oliver_cust: Org: org-4821, claim_ref: CLM-20260303-9a7b. Email says: "Your credits have been applied to account org-4821 (CLM-20260303-9a7b)." Time roughly 2026-03-03 14:12 PST.

maria_support: Thanks. I'm going to check the internal claim ingestion logs and ledger for that claim id. Will update shortly.

billing-bot: webhook: /api/v1/promos/claims 200 OK - payload accepted - claim_id=CLM-20260303-9a7b - partner=partner-giveaway - mapped_tenant=org-4821

maria_support: The webhook shows 200 OK and mapping to org-4821, which matches the email. I still don't see the ledger entry. Tyler, can you help check whether the grant recorded to the ledger?

tyler_eng: Running a quick ledger lookup now: 
```
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer REDWOOD-INTERNAL" "https://internal.redwood/api/ledger/entries?claim_ref=CLM-20260303-9a7b" | jq '.'
```
Response: `[]` (no entries). Also checking claims table: `select id, tenant_id, amount_cents, status from promo_claims where claim_ref='CLM-20260303-9a7b';` returns `id: 91827, tenant_id: 'org-4821', amount_cents: 50000, status: 'ingested'`

maria_support: So claim exists in claims table and webhook accepted it, but ledger has no entry. Any recent jobs that move ingested claims into ledger?

tyler_eng: There's a nightly ingestion worker + realtime pipeline. I checked the realtime worker logs around 2026-03-03 14:12 and saw this warning:
```
[2026-03-03T21:12:45Z] WARN pipeline.claim-processor: grant mapping key mismatch for claim_id=91827, expected billing_profile_id not found
```
Looks like the claim didn't have an associated billing_profile_id so the processor skipped ledger write.

maria_support: That would explain no balance change. Oliver — do you have a billing profile attached to the org? Any paid billing account or connector?

oliver_cust: We only have the default billing profile created at signup, never added a card. The promo should still apply to org balance for free-trial credits.

tyler_eng: The processor expects a billing_profile in certain grant flows (partner grants were recently tightened). From logs the claim's metadata has `billing_profile_id: null`. I can see two remediation options: 1) backfill the billing_profile_id for this claim to the org's default profile and run the worker to create the ledger entry (fast), or 2) manually create a ledger credit tied to org-4821 (requires audit ticket and bookkeeping). Which do we prefer?

maria_support: For a customer-facing fix, backfill + re-run worker is faster and audit-safe if we document the change. I will confirm with finance. @billing-bot any objections?

billing-bot: finance-check: backfill allowed for promotional grants below $1000 per customer when billing_profile exists on tenant. flag: needs_audit_log. No policy-block.

maria_support: OK let's proceed with backfill + reprocess. Tyler, ETA?

tyler_eng: I will run a one-off migration: `update promo_claims set billing_profile_id='bp-default-org-4821' where id=91827;` then enqueue claim 91827 to claim-processor queue. Expect ledger write within 2 minutes of enqueue. Doing it now.

tyler_eng: Migration applied and claim enqueued. Watching logs...

tyler_eng: `INFO pipeline.claim-processor: created ledger_entry id=LE-554301 for tenant=org-4821 amount_cents=50000`

maria_support: Oliver, can you refresh your billing page? It may take a minute to show.

oliver_cust: Refreshing... I now see $500.00 credit in the org balance. Thank you! :tada:

maria_support: Great — closing loop. We'll add a follow-up to improve the partner ingestion validations so billing_profile_id is not required for partner free credits or we default it earlier. I'll open a follow-up ticket in product/eng.

\olmaria_support: Note for records: audit ticket AT-3321 created for the backfill and include the command + justification.
\tyler_eng: Follow-up: adding a unit test for claim processor to catch null billing_profile_id in partner flows.
\oliver_cust: Appreciate the quick turnaround. One ask: can you add a log line in the confirmation email or UI that shows claim_ref so we can reference it easily?

maria_support: Good suggestion — forwarding to product. Closing thread once ticket is in Jira. :white_check_mark:
